task: FA6 -- the CFS masking channel: exact linear model of the mask channel per slot, the M opening, negative controls, the Rust cross-check fixture
reviewer: Claude Fable 5.1, independent privacy reviewer, 2026-09-08 session

model.mask: g(x) = a_0 + a' prod_j x_j + sum_j sum_{e=1..d} a_{j,e} x_j^e over N = n_vars variables (N d + 2 coefficients); round j: 2^(N-1-j) (a_0 + sum_{i<j} u_i(r_i) + sum_{i>j} u_i(1)/2 + u_j(X)) + a' (prod_{i<j} r_i) X
model.view: per masked sumcheck: the claimed sum's g-part (c G, or Gamma as batched), the N round messages' g-parts c g_j(0..d) (the last round(s) = the extension round(s)), the derived g(rho) = h_{N-1}(r_{N-1})/c - f-part, all as Fp2-linear functionals of the coefficients
model.consistency_subspace: S = {view : h_0(0)+h_0(1) = claim, h_j(0)+h_j(1) = interp(h_{j-1})(r_{j-1})}; dim S = N d + 1 per slot; f-part in S, so surjectivity of the map onto S makes f + L(a) uniform on S for every f
model.verdict_rule: rank(map) == dim S and image inside S  =>  the masked view is uniform on S, independent of the data (perfect hiding of the message channel); otherwise a leaked functional and a two-data counterexample are exhibited
